items.note: Synthetic-control analysis of 824,634 podcast episodes plus a preregistered experiment (N = 496) shows people adopt ChatGPT-preferred words after a brief chatbot interaction; the outcome is lexical adoption, not creativity or diversity, and homogenization appears only as a concern in the closing sentence.

Abstract not reachable (OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, Europe PMC, SSRN page, web search all failed); the title suggests a study of LLM help on hypothesis generation with an effort mechanism, so it is kept as a possible experiment for full-text check.

Meta-analysis of 44 studies (141 effect sizes) comparing human-only and human-AI creative task performance, pooled Hedges' g = 0.54 [0.27, 0.81], larger for non-experts and general domains; abstract taken from the OSF preprint record.
Firefox add-on ecosystem before and after ChatGPT's release: new add-ons rose 34 percent and drew on broader knowledge domains but were not substantially more novel than existing ones.

Participants randomly assigned to write stories with Story Forge (card-based AI tool) or a web-based AI story tool (AI-vs-AI configuration); outcomes include engagement, narrative outcomes, and emotions, and it is unclear whether the stories themselves are rated; N not stated.

One survey and two between-subjects experiments manipulating high versus low AI dependence (Study 3 a 2 x 2 with thinking orientation) and measuring students' creativity with critical thinking as mediator; the abstract does not say how creativity is measured, whether AI was used during the task, or N.

Within-subjects study of 16 pre-service SLPs configuring visual scene displays with a GenAI hotspot-suggestion prototype versus Snap Scene; quality and homogenization of communication options are assessed; N is below 50 and the counterbalancing of order is not stated (abstract from arXiv 2507.21811).

Survey finds 34 percent of online participants report using LLMs for open-ended answers, and simulations show LLM-generated responses are more homogeneous than human responses from three pre-ChatGPT studies; no participant receives AI help in a scored comparison.

Within-subjects study in which 31 designers completed both a traditional and an AI-expert-assisted design process; 62 design outcomes were rated higher on effectiveness, completeness, and applicability with AI; N below 50 and order randomization not stated (abstract from the PolyU research portal).

Links PubMed Central and OpenAlex for 775,323 scientists and finds more interdisciplinary and exploratory publishing after 2022, especially among authors with stronger AI-writing signals; outcomes are research exploration and team roles rather than idea novelty, so it may be out at full text.
